script_text: Stop, Aries, the sky just tightened around your name. This aspect turns restlessness into real authority, especially around long-term goals, publishing, or travel. In love, the 7th House of partnership wants a mature conversation; if you are single, steady warmth attracts you more than flashy pursuit. For career and money, your 10th House rewards a visible commitment: sign the agreement, post the proof, or ask for the role you have outgrown. Your 2nd House also asks you to separate a genuine opportunity from an impulse buy. Avoid arguing with someone who controls resources or reputation, and expect a mentor to appear through a professional circle. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
